title: How plants help us: observing things around us
brief_description: A young boy bicycling to his uncle’s farm observes the plants around him and discovers that plants are helpful in many ways. Explains that people are dependent upon plants for food, clothing, wood, paper, rubber and many other common articles important in their daily lives.
